data.title: Two flats, one ordinary weekday
data.situation: After the viewing, the agent suggested another flat across town. It had not made Lin's shortlist because the journey looked long, but she went to compare its larger rooms and lower price. The first flat was small and had a kitchen window needing repair, but it stood on a quiet street, a fifteen-minute walk from work. Its monthly rent was £90 higher. The new flat was spacious enough for her desk and stayed within her budget. Yet traffic outside its bedroom brought constant noise, and the commute would take nearly an hour by bus. After a late shift, that wait at the stop would be tiring. The trade-off was clearer now. On balance, she preferred the smaller flat, although she still needed an answer about the repair. She would also check the bus route at rush hour and compare full monthly costs before choosing.
data.goal: Compare two flats by space, noise, rent, and commute; explain a provisional preference and what to check before choosing.
data.zhSupport: 林把刚看过、厨房窗户仍有问题的近单位公寓，与中介新推荐的一套更宽敞但靠大路的房子相比。她需要衡量月租、空间、噪音和每天通勤；先说出暂定偏好，再核实维修、高峰路线与完整费用。

glossary.note: 形容房间或住房空间大、活动余地足；可说 a spacious flat。
monthly 修饰名词 rent；这里是每月付给房东的租金，是否包括账单还要核实。
within her budget 表示在她能安排的预算范围内；仍须核对全部费用。
这里指卧室外道路持续传来的声音；可说 road noise。
这里是名词，指每天往返住处与工作地点的行程；a long commute 是通勤时间长。
可数名词；a trade-off between space and travel time 表示空间与通勤时间之间的取舍。
在提到两边的利弊后，用 on balance 引出总体判断；不表示其他疑问都已解决。
指早晚大量人通勤、道路或公共交通较拥挤的时段；at rush hour 表示在高峰时段。

glossary.zh: 比较一个优势与另一个代价
glossary.note: 比较双方同一维度，再补另一项代价；more不是所有形容词的唯一比较方式。
matchTexts: The second flat is more spacious, but it is farther from work.

glossary.note: although引出让步；主句用I would说明在给定条件下的选择，不把although和but一起连接同一对分句。
matchTexts: Although the nearer flat costs more, I would choose it for the shorter walk.

retrievalPrompts.cue: The flat near work has little desk space and costs £90 more each month. The other has room for a desk and is cheaper. Compare them.
acceptableAnswers: The second flat is more spacious and has lower monthly rent, but it is farther from work.
The flat near work is smaller and costs £90 more a month, while the other gives me room for a desk and fits my budget.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Spacious describes the usable room; monthly rent is the regular housing payment. Compare both flats on the same points, and check later whether bills are included.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 近公司的房子放书桌的空间小，月费贵90英镑；另一套更大、更便宜。比较空间和费用。
checks: 不要把低租金直接说成低总费用。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 比较空间和月租，并保留后续核对账单的必要。

retrievalPrompts.cue: The cheaper flat is beside a busy road. Its bus journey to work takes nearly an hour before peak traffic. Explain the everyday cost of choosing it.
acceptableAnswers: The spacious flat is cheaper, but the road noise and nearly hour-long commute would affect me every day.
It has more room, but the bedroom is noisy and the bus journey takes almost an hour, perhaps longer at rush hour.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Name the source of the noise and give the known journey time. The rush-hour time has not been measured, so describe that part as a possibility.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 便宜的房子临主路，平常坐公交到公司已将近一小时。说明这会怎样影响每天的生活。
checks: 高峰期更久只能说可能，不能当实测结果。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 把日常噪音和路程联系到生活；已知与未核实的时间分开。

retrievalPrompts.cue: You value quiet and time after late shifts more than desk space. Explain what you gain and give up, then state your present preference.
acceptableAnswers: The trade-off is less space and higher rent for a quieter home and a much shorter commute. On balance, I prefer the flat near work.
Although the nearer flat costs more and is smaller, I would choose it for the quiet street and shorter walk, provided I can afford the total cost.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: A clear choice names both the benefit and the cost. On balance introduces your overall view after comparing the options; it does not mean every issue is settled.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 你晚班后更看重安静和时间，胜过书桌空间。说出获得什么、放弃什么，再给出当前偏好。
checks: 给出与晚班生活有关的理由。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 可以用取舍名词，也可以直接说选择理由；合理改述都有效。

retrievalPrompts.function: State a provisional choice and checks
retrievalPrompts.cue: You favour the near-work flat, but its kitchen window needs repair. You have not checked the full costs or the second bus route at peak time. Say which flat you favour and what you will check.
acceptableAnswers: On balance, I prefer the flat near work, but I will ask whether the window can be repaired and check the full monthly cost before deciding.
I am leaning toward the smaller flat. I will check the repair and costs, and test the other commute at rush hour.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Prefer or lean toward can express a tentative choice. Ask whether the repair will be arranged, check the total monthly cost, and test the other route at a realistic travel time before making a final decision.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 你倾向近公司的房子，但窗户还要修，完整费用与另一条公交线的高峰用时也没核实。说明偏好和下一项检查。
checks: 至少说出一个未决问题。
不要声称维修或费用已确认。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 暂定偏好后列出核实事项，留出改变判断的空间。

transferPrompt.function: Transfer comparison and choice language to two student rooms
transferPrompt.cue: A friend is choosing between a small, quiet room ten minutes from college and a larger room beside a main road. The larger room is £60 cheaper each month but needs a forty-minute bus ride. Without reopening Lin's story, compare the four factors, give a tentative choice, and name one fact to check.
acceptableAnswers: The larger room is cheaper and more spacious, but the road noise and forty-minute bus ride would bother me. On balance, I prefer the small room, provided its full monthly cost fits my budget.
I would probably take the room near college. I would give up some space and pay £60 more for quiet and a short journey. I would check whether bills are included before agreeing.
transferPrompt.feedback: Use the new prices and journey times. State what you gain and give up, make a provisional choice, and identify one missing fact; either room can be a reasonable choice if you explain it.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 朋友在两间学生房之间选择：小房安静、步行到学校10分钟；大房临主路，每月便宜60英镑，但坐车40分钟。比较四项因素，给暂定选择，并说一个要核实的事实。
checks: 使用60英镑与40分钟的新信息。
比较空间、钱、声音和路程。
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: 两种选择都可以；理由和待核实事实要符合新情境。

data.easySummary: Lin compares two flats. The flat near work is smaller and costs more. The other has more space and lower rent, but it is noisy and far from work. Lin prefers the first for now, but still needs to check the repair and full cost.
data.easySummaryZh: 林比较两套房。近公司的那套更小、更贵；另一套更大、租金更低，但吵且离公司远。她暂时偏好第一套，仍要核实维修与完整费用。
